name: Andalo (Italy)
description: Horizontal bicolour of green and white, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Andalo (a brown bear on white).
history: Municipal flag of Andalo, a comune in Trentino-South Tyrol; Italian municipal arms, gonfaloni and flags are granted by decree of the President of the Republic on the advice of the Government's heraldry office.

features.role: Andalo arms — brown bear on white, crowned
